<!-- pr-reviewer: d5f32a6a5f65fc3f799550e1af9bf7435e3da17c -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** - one blocker, and it is about merge order, not the code under review.

**What looks good**
- Helix geometry checked by hand against the kernel (`thread_mill.rs`, `thread_ride.rs`): the internal lead-in is the semicircle from the axis, tangent to the centre circle and on the helix; the lead-out mirrors it. Climb under M3 orbits a hole counter-clockwise, and counter-clockwise plus rising gives a right-hand thread. Lead is one pitch per turn. Every pass shares one helix. Radial passes are equal and the last lands on 0.5413 x pitch, so crests never pass the major circle.
- A single-form mill rides whole turns; a multi-form mill makes one revolution per level, with levels one cutting length (rows x pitch) apart, and `rows` comes from `flute_len / pitch`.
- The tip stays at or above the floor (a through hole gets one extra pitch), no rapid runs below the feature top, and the run-out above the retract plane is refused by name.
- Refusals by name, at command creation, edit, retype and re-tool (`gates.rs` `thread_gate`) and again at generate: a mill no smaller than the minor diameter ("no air to enter"), a pitch outside the range or not the multi-form's, a form other than 60 degrees, infeed past the thread depth, a non-positive or non-finite pitch, a stepped hole.
- The tool sanity law is in `tools/src/thread_mill.rs`. The kinds are covered by tool JSON and project round-trip tests, and MCP is covered by `thread_milling_over_the_tools`. `pitch_min` and the new op fields are additive with serde defaults, so an old file loads as unstated pitch and right hand. A Tap on an old Thread op gets the tool law's after-state and refuses to generate. The body states the breaking changes. Goldens are additions only and are explained.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in non-test code, provenance lines are present, and the decision file is present. No process files, `build.rs`, `.github` or dependencies are touched, and there are no snapshot PNG or CHANGELOG edits. The Changelog line and the effort line are present. Clean-room note: the catalog entries are generic.

**Local results** (merged with current upstream/main, clean merge, no conflicts; sccache, own `target/`)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (the diff falls back to the batch plan) | 4 steps, 0 failed, 11.0 min. Together the steps ran 3295 passed, 0 failed, 66 ignored. |
| tools suites | ok |
| motion suites (incl. `machining2d`, `solid_law`) | ok |
| app suites (incl. `thread_mill`, `mill2d_c`, `golden_cl`, `mcp`, `tool_law`, `tool_gate`, `project_roundtrip`) | ok |
| ui suites | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. The newly reachable undrilled-hole path (#992, now P0) ships with this PR. The ride feeds a non-centre-cutting mill straight down the hole axis, and nothing here checks that an earlier operation opened the hole (see "Known gap" in the body). The fix is PR #1045, stacked on this branch. Both PRs are mergeable independently, so a plain merge of #1005 (for example through `/merge-ready`) would put that path on `main` alone. Please fold the #1045 fix into this branch (or make the pairing impossible to get wrong), so the merge of #1005 never ships a Thread operation that can post over an unopened hole. Once that is pushed, a delta re-review should be quick.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- Only the Fanuc output was exercised. Heidenhain, Sinumerik, Tormach and plasma posts were not run on a thread program. Only the inverted-machine path refuses a helical arc by name (`post/invert.rs:240`). A follow-up pinning one more dialect's G2/G3-with-Z (or its refusal) would be good.
- The crossing law stands down for the whole Thread op. It is justified in the decision file, and the crest, root and rapid laws still judge, but the stand-down covers the entire op, not just retraced helix pairs.
- External threads are kernel-only (#985); the operation passes `external: false`, so the boss approach arcs are exercised by tests and a golden only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ac1f7aaddc8df2c65f94603045b653cdff66c1ef -->
**Verdict: Needs a refresh before merge - the code is clean, but it conflicts with current main, and it must merge together with #1045.** Reviewed at ac1f7aad (full review, PROCESS_VERSION 32; the author's session is UMA, so this review is independent of it).

**The #992 blocker from the review at d5f32a6a**
- It is not fixed inside this PR, and it does not need to be. Nothing in `thread_op.rs` or the Thread arm of `generate.rs` reads the earlier operations' stock (`drill_prior` is not used on the Thread path), so a Thread op on a modelled hole with no drill before it still generates and verifies clean on this head. That is the documented known gap, filed as #992 (open, P1, in-review).
- It legitimately rides on #1045 (fixes #992; it is itself a draft, `conflicts`, base `main`). The right state is "merge together": #1045 merges with or immediately after this PR, inside the same cut, with nothing else reaching main between them. This PR on its own (a `feat!`, so it merges at the cut anyway) would make an unguarded thread path reachable. The earlier needs-rework label was about that order, not about code in this head, so I am removing it; the order stays a condition for the maintainer.

**#1205 reconciliation (4b1c9c08, ac1f7aad): main's solid law is kept, no wider credit**
- The new `verify::hole_is_round` (`crates/sim/src/verify/hole_wall.rs`) reuses main's `facet_sag` and `WALL_SAG` (not duplicated). It answers `false` on any non-finite input or non-finite facet, and on any reachable wall facet whose sagitta is over 0.05 mm. Reach is minor r + depth + `WALL_SAG`, over the thread's Z span.
- `thread_op::walls_round` gates both the crest region (`generate.rs:2069-2070`) and `root_cutter`. When it is false the op keeps its region's own rim and the full tooth radius, which is main's reading. The extra crest/root credit applies only over a fine circle, where main's own law already reads the wall as round. A single polygonal hole puts the whole op back on the strict reading.
- Mutation checks, each restored afterwards (tree clean):
  1. `walls_round` forced `true`: `hole_wall_flats::a_thread_mill_cutting_into_an_octagons_flats_is_a_gouge` fails (as intended).
  2. Sagitta threshold `<= WALL_SAG` loosened to `<= 1.0`: the octagon test and the sim unit test `a_hole_is_round_only_while_its_reachable_wall_is_a_fine_circle` both fail.
  3. Reach cut to 10%: the octagon test and the sim unit test both fail.

**What looks good**
- Breaking footer present (`BREAKING CHANGE:` in the feat commit: a Thread op no longer accepts a Tap-kind tool); tool law refuses Tap-as-thread-mill by name (`tool_law.rs:42-43`). `ThreadMill`/`ThreadMillSingle` are additive project words (`project/file.rs:413`), so no migration rung is needed; no older file names them.
- No `unwrap/expect/panic!` added outside test code. No process files, snapshot PNGs, build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependencies touched. Icons are original (`assets/ui/svg/tool-thread-mill*.svg`). Thread goldens are new additions, regenerated byte-identical after the law fix; the new golden is judged in `posted_gates/thread.rs`, not left `UNJUDGED`.
- Provenance lines present on the new modules.

**Local results (head ac1f7aad, NOT merged with current main - see conflicts)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app: thread_mill / solid_law / solid_law_goldens | 8 / 4 / 6 passed |
| app: mill2d_b / mill2d_c / operations / golden_cl | 9 / 9 / 117 (6 ign.) / 28 passed |
| app: drill_prior / hole_wall_flats / tap_sim | 12 / 5 / 2 passed |
| app: tool_law / tool_gate / project_roundtrip / mcp / recorded_post_streams | 4 / 9 / 71 / 19 / 2 passed |
| app lib / tools / sim lib / motion lib / center_cut_owed | 201 / 73 / 95 / 95-class / 7 passed, 0 failed |
| ui lib, single-threaded (crates/ui) | 609 passed, 5 ignored |
| clippy tools+motion+sim+app+ui, `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

(`thread_mill_rim` is not a suite name on this head; the thread rim cases live in `thread_mill` and `hole_wall_flats`.)

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge current `upstream/main` into the branch. The trial merge conflicts in 26 files (hunks): `assets/tools/catalog.json` (1), `app/src/operation/{generate.rs 1, mod.rs 1, stamp.rs 2}`, `app/src/project/file.rs` (3), tests `golden_cl.rs 2, hole_wall_flats.rs 1, mcp.rs 2, mill2d_b.rs 1, mill2d_c.rs 1, operations.rs 1, solid_law_goldens.rs 1, tool_law.rs 2`, `motion/src/drilling/tests.rs`, `motion/tests/center_cut_owed.rs`, `sim/src/verify/mod.rs`, `tools/src/{catalog_asset.rs 2, catalog_asset_tests.rs, lib.rs, tools.rs 4}`, `ui/src/egui_app/{browser_tree.rs, icons.rs, mod.rs, pages.rs 3, tool_icons.rs}`, `ui/src/state.rs` (2). Mostly both-sides-added lists (tool kinds, icons, UI rows, tests) but `generate.rs`, `sim/verify/mod.rs`, `tools.rs` and `file.rs` are shared logic - a judgement merge by the author, not something I resolved. I reviewed and tested the head as pushed; the merged tree was not built, so after the refresh the thread suites, `solid_law_goldens` and `hole_wall_flats` need a re-run, and this head needs a delta check.
2. Keep the merge order: this PR, then #1045 (retarget/refresh onto refreshed main), within one cut.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Other post dialects: only Fanuc and the inverted-axis refusal are pinned for G2/G3 with Z.
- The per-operation round-wall check is stricter, never looser (one polygonal hole puts all of the op's holes on the full-radius reading).
- External threads (#985), thread form in the stock sim (#986), forms other than 60 degrees (#987) are tracked, not claimed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
